seedNote: Hand-researched seed set covering 29 Aug - 31 Dec 2026. All dates verified against the sources listed unless dateConfidence says otherwise.

events.name: Vuelta a España
events.place: Monaco → Granada. 21 stages, 3,275km, 58,000m of climbing, seven mountain stages
events.angle: Your strongest card and the last Grand Tour of the year. One 3D climb morph per mountain stage, published the night before. Final week is Andalusia — Peñas Blancas 11 Sep, Collado del Alguacil 12 Sep, Granada finish 13 Sep.
events.postWindow: Daily, 18:00–20:00 UK, the evening before each mountain stage

events.name: UCI MTB World Championships
events.place: Val di Sole, Italy — XCO, short track, relay, E-MTB and downhill on the Black Snake
events.angle: Gradient and gearing explainer: what XCO climbing gears look like next to a Grand Tour climb. Feeds the gear calculator.
events.postWindow: Live now — daily clips through Sun 30 Aug

events.name: Badlands
events.place: Granada to Almería, Spain — roughly 800km and 16,000m, self-supported ultra
events.angle: Ultra gearing: what you actually run for 16,000m unsupported. Dot-watching gives you a week of content from one post.
events.postWindow: Starts tomorrow — schedule tonight, then follow the trackers all week

events.name: UK cyclocross league season
events.place: Nationwide — regional leagues and the National Trophy series run September to January. Cheap entry, open to all ages
events.angle: The easiest way for your readers to start racing. A "your first cross race" guide — tyres, pressure, gearing, what actually happens — pulls traffic every autumn from now on.
events.postWindow: Publish the beginner guide in the first week of September, refresh each October

events.name: Lloyds Tour of Britain Men
events.place: Lincoln → Earlston, Scottish Borders. Five stages, 910km, 8,814m. Free to watch roadside
events.angle: Home traffic. Michaelgate in Lincoln averages 11.3% and is climbed five times on stage 1 — build a UK climb page and cross-link it to the Grand Tour set. Stage 4 Helmsley–Leyburn over the Moors and Dales is the decisive day.
events.postWindow: Michaelgate page live Mon 31 Aug, then a post per stage day

events.name: Deloitte Ride Across Britain
events.place: Land's End to John o' Groats — nine days, around 980 miles, fully supported
events.angle: LEJOG planning is an evergreen search term with real volume — daily mileage, gearing for nine consecutive days, what breaks. Publish the guide now and it earns every year.
events.postWindow: LEJOG gearing guide Wed 2 Sep. Organiser lists 5–13 Sep, one aggregator says 6–14 — confirm

events.name: MyWhoosh Sunday Race Club — Esports Worlds qualifiers
events.place: Virtual, worldwide. Open-access qualifying on the first two Sundays of September
events.angle: Anyone can qualify for a world championship from a spare room. Around 30 places per gender come through these open races — almost nobody has written that plainly.
events.postWindow: Explainer Fri 4 Sep, before the first Sunday

events.name: Rebecca's Private Idaho
events.place: Sun Valley and Ketchum, Idaho — four routes from the 19-mile Tater Tot to the 126-mile Twice Baked. Main event Saturday 12th. Moved to the weekend after Labor Day for 2026
events.angle: The friendliest big US gravel event — a 19-mile route next to a 126-mile one on the same day. Perfect peg for a "which gravel distance should you actually enter" piece, with gearing for each.
events.postWindow: Distance-choice guide Mon 7 Sep; event posts 10–12 Sep

events.name: RideCymru
events.place: Llandudno to Cardiff — three days across Wales, hotel or supported camping. 2026 sold out
events.angle: Welsh climbs are under-served on your site and easy to reach. Build two or three Welsh climb pages off the back of it and take the 2027 entry traffic. Clash on 2026-09-11: also competing for the feed post against UCI MTB Marathon World Championships and Bespoked Dresden.
events.postWindow: Welsh climbs piece Tue 8 Sep; ride days 11–13 Sep

events.name: UCI MTB Marathon World Championships
events.place: Primiero San Martino di Castrozza, Italy — Masters categories included for the first time
events.angle: A rainbow jersey now open to Masters riders. Strong hook for the 45+ audience — pair with marathon gearing. Clash on 2026-09-11: also competing for the feed post against RideCymru and Bespoked Dresden.
events.postWindow: Thu 10 Sep preview, results Sun 13 Sep

events.name: Bespoked Dresden
events.place: Dresden Airport, Germany — Europe's biggest handmade bike show, 7,000+ visitors
events.angle: Craft posts travel further than product posts and carry no affiliate baggage. Steel, custom geometry, the people who build them. Clash on 2026-09-11: also competing for the feed post against RideCymru and UCI MTB Marathon World Championships.
events.postWindow: Teaser Wed 9 Sep, carousels 11–13 Sep

events.name: Grand Prix Cycliste de Québec
events.place: Québec City, Canada — WorldTour one-day
events.angle: Warm-up act for Worlds. Use it to launch the Mont Royal build a week early.
events.postWindow: Fri 11 Sep, single post

events.name: Grand Prix Cycliste de Montréal
events.place: Montréal, Canada — the Mont Royal circuit, a preview of the Worlds course
events.angle: Publish the Mont Royal / Camillien-Houde climb page here. It then does the work twice, again during Worlds week.
events.postWindow: Sat 12 Sep evening — this page must be live before the 20th

events.name: Marji Gesick
events.place: Marquette and Ishpeming, Michigan — 100 miles of brutal singletrack with a famously low finish rate. Dates approximate, confirm with the organiser
events.angle: The DNF rate is the story — an event most entrants do not finish. Good "what actually breaks people" content, and gearing for 100 miles of singletrack is a real question.
events.postWindow: Only if the September slot is thin; Chequamegon is the bigger event that weekend

events.name: Chequamegon MTB Festival
events.place: Hayward to Cable, Wisconsin — 40 miles on the Birkebeiner ski trail, plus a 16-mile Short & Fat. Oldest MTB race in the US, entry by lottery. Expo Friday 18th
events.angle: 41st edition, thousands of riders, autumn colour in the Northwoods, and a genuinely beginner-friendly 16-mile option alongside the pro race. The lottery entry system is worth explaining on its own.
events.postWindow: Preview Wed 16 Sep; race and festival posts Sat 19 Sep

events.name: UCI Road World Championships
events.place: Montréal, Canada. 13 events, all finishing on Avenue du Parc. Time trials 20–22 Sep, elite road races 26–27 Sep
events.angle: Biggest road audience of the autumn. The 13.4km circuit climbs 269m a lap: Camillien-Houde at 2.3km/6.2%, Polytechnique over 11% in places. Lap-by-lap 3D morph is the piece.
events.postWindow: Circuit breakdown Fri 18 Sep; TT posts 20–22 Sep; road races 24–27 Sep

events.name: 3 Peaks Cyclo-Cross
events.place: Yorkshire Dales — 62nd edition. The hardest and biggest CX race in Britain, entry by experience panel, 35mm tyre limit
events.angle: Carrying a cross bike over Ingleborough is the most photogenic thing in British cycling and there is barely any good data content on it. Gradient profiles of the three climbs, plus the tyre rule as a talking point.
events.postWindow: Course profile piece Thu 24 Sep; race-day gallery Sun 27 Sep

events.name: UCI MTB World Cup — Whistler
events.place: Whistler, Canada
events.angle: Descending and tyre pressure. Low effort, decent reach.
events.postWindow: Sun 27 Sep

events.name: UCI Cycling Esports World Championships — semi-final
events.place: Virtual, on MyWhoosh
events.angle: Follow-up to the September qualifiers. Power-to-weight and trainer calibration are the natural companion pieces.
events.postWindow: Fri 2 Oct

reviewLog.note: UCI/MyWhoosh confirm the semi-final is entirely virtual on MyWhoosh on 2 October 2026, matching the listed date and venue.

events.name: L'Eroica, Gaiole in Chianti
events.place: Tuscany — vintage gran fondo on the strade bianche. Long routes Sat 3rd (209km, 135km), main day Sun 4th (106/81/46km). Pre-1987 steel bikes only
events.angle: Downtube shifters and no compact cranks — a funny gear-calculator story about what ratios riders actually had before 1987. Highly shareable and it sends people straight to your tool.
events.postWindow: "Gearing before 1987" piece Thu 1 Oct; ride-day posts Sun 4 Oct

reviewLog.note: Confirmed Sat 3 - Sun 4 October 2026 with the same five route distances.

events.name: UCI Gran Fondo Chile
events.place: Región de Los Ríos, Chile — first UCI gran fondo in the country, qualifier for the 2027 amateur Worlds
events.angle: The peg for a plain-English guide to gran fondo qualification: finish in the top 25% of your age group at any World Series round and you get a start at the amateur Worlds. Very few sites explain it properly.
events.postWindow: Qualification guide Thu 1 Oct — it then serves every gran fondo below

reviewLog.note: UCI Gran Fondo World Series materials confirm the 4 October 2026 date in the Region de Los Rios (Lago Ranco).

events.name: UCI MTB World Cup — Lake Placid
events.place: Lake Placid, New York — closing rounds of the XCO series
events.angle: Lake Placid is now confirmed as a three-day World Cup weekend (XCO and downhill both decided), not a single Sunday — worth a short downhill/XCO double post instead of one race-day update.
events.postWindow: Fri 2 - Sun 4 Oct, single wrap post after Sunday's elite races

reviewLog.note: The Lake Placid round is a three-day event (Fri 2 - Sun 4 October 2026, XCO and DHI World Cups both decided that weekend), not the single day previously listed.

events.priorityRationale: Still a light-touch, low-priority US round for this audience; the extra day doesn't change the site's stake in it.

events.name: Roc d'Azur
events.place: Fréjus and Roquebrune-sur-Argens, France — 34 events, 20,000 riders, 300 exhibitors, 150,000 visitors. Gravel expanded for 2026
events.angle: The biggest participation event in the sport and almost invisible in English. Entry-level races alongside elites, a free test camp and a bike show — that combination is your gap in the market.
events.postWindow: Preview Mon 5 Oct; daily posts 8–11 Oct

reviewLog.note: Confirmed 42nd edition runs 7-11 October 2026 in Frejus/Roquebrune-sur-Argens with an expanded gravel offering.

events.name: UCI Gravel World Championships
events.place: Nannup, Western Australia — first outside Europe. 140.7km men / 123.1km women, over 80% gravel, 3,000m+. Women and men 50+ Saturday, elite men and 19–49 men Sunday
events.angle: Age-group racing is the whole story — ordinary riders lining up for a rainbow jersey. Reuse the qualification explainer and add the Nannup course profile. Clash on 2026-10-10: also competing for the feed post against Il Lombardia.
events.postWindow: Course and qualification post Wed 7 Oct; races 10-11 Oct, early UK mornings

reviewLog.note: Dates, distances, elevation and the Saturday/Sunday schedule all confirmed as-is; tightened the official URL from the uci.org homepage to the specific competition-hub page.

events.priorityRationale: Confirmed UK morning watch window and a genuine amateur-entry story make this one of the strongest posts of October; no change from the seed rationale.

events.name: Il Lombardia
events.place: Bergamo → Como, 252km. 120th edition, the final Monument of the season
events.angle: The Ghisallo. Autumn light, the cyclists' chapel, and a climb page that pulls traffic every October from here on. Clashes with Gravel Worlds — schedule both. Clash on 2026-10-10: also competing for the feed post against UCI Gravel World Championships.
events.postWindow: Ghisallo page Wed 7 Oct; race thread Sat 10 Oct

reviewLog.note: Confirmed Saturday 10 October 2026, Bergamo to Como, 252km, 120th edition and season-closing Monument.

events.name: Hong Kong Cyclothon
events.place: Hong Kong — new 56km 'Five Tunnels, Three Bridges' mass ride via the Central Kowloon Bypass, plus the returning 32km 'Two Tunnels, Two Bridges' route, start/finish relocated to Museum Drive, West Kowloon Cultural District, alongside a UCI Class 1.1 elite road race on a new 100km course
events.angle: The 2026 route is a genuine rebuild — a new 56km 'Five Tunnels, Three Bridges' mass ride from the West Kowloon Cultural District and a new 100km elite course. Worth a proper route-change post rather than the generic closed-motorway angle used before.
events.postWindow: Route-change post Wed 7 Oct; event post Sun 11 Oct

changes.from: Hong Kong — mass participation ride across the harbour bridges plus a UCI race
changes.to: Hong Kong — new 56km 'Five Tunnels, Three Bridges' mass ride via the Central Kowloon Bypass, plus the returning 32km 'Two Tunnels, Two Bridges' route, start/finish relocated to Museum Drive, West Kowloon Cultural District, alongside a UCI Class 1.1 elite road race on a new 100km course

reviewLog.note: Date confirmed as Sunday 11 October 2026, but the organiser page (Hong Kong Tourism Board) is a better official source than uci.org and the mass-ride route has materially changed for 2026.

events.priorityRationale: Still optional unless chasing the Asia audience — the route rebuild is a nice-to-have story, not a reason to raise priority.

events.name: Tour of Guangxi
events.place: Guangxi, China — closes the men's and women's WorldTour on 18 Oct
events.angle: Season-closing round-up: the year in climbs ranked by your own data. Repackages what you already have.
events.postWindow: Season wrap published Sun 18 Oct

reviewLog.note: Dates (13-18 October 2026) and role as the season-closing round of both WorldTours confirmed via race calendars.

events.name: Life Time Big Sugar Gravel
events.place: Bentonville, Arkansas — 100, 50 or 25 miles of Ozark chunk. Life Time Grand Prix finale, amateurs on the same course as the pros
events.angle: Tyre choice and pressure for sharp gravel is the most-searched question of that week. Autumn colour photography carries it on Instagram. Clash on 2026-10-17: also competing for the feed post against Gran Fondo Hincapie — Greenville.
events.postWindow: Tyre pressure piece Wed 14 Oct; race posts Sat 17 Oct

reviewLog.note: Confirmed Saturday 17 October 2026 in Bentonville, Arkansas, Life Time Grand Prix finale with 100/50/25-mile distances.

events.name: Gran Fondo Hincapie — Greenville
events.place: Travelers Rest, South Carolina — 15th anniversary. Gran, Medio and a family Piccolo route through the Blue Ridge foothills
events.angle: The most welcoming big US road fondo, with a genuine family route. Same day as Big Sugar, so pick one for the main post and give the other a story slot. Clash on 2026-10-17: also competing for the feed post against Life Time Big Sugar Gravel.
events.postWindow: Sat 17 Oct — Big Sugar takes the feed post, Hincapie takes stories

reviewLog.note: Confirmed 15th-anniversary event Saturday 17 October 2026, Travelers Rest SC, Gran/Medio/Piccolo routes.

events.name: Granfondo La Nucia
events.place: La Nucia, Alicante, Spain — UCI World Series qualifier in the region WorldTeams use for winter training
events.angle: The reachable one for UK riders. Ties into winter training-camp content and your Stay22 and Booking.com links — Alicante and Calpe are the search terms.
events.postWindow: Winter training camp guide Mon 12 Oct, with the event as the hook

reviewLog.note: UCI's own listings confirm Granfondo La Nucia as a World Series qualifier on 18 October 2026.

events.name: Tour de France 2027 route presentation
events.place: Palais des Congrès, Paris. Late October, exact date not yet published. The 2027 Grand Départ is Edinburgh, with stage 1 heading for Carlisle
events.angle: The biggest single traffic day of your autumn. Every climb in the 2027 route gets searched within hours of the reveal, and a British Grand Départ adds UK volume on top. Have page templates ready. The 2027 Étape du Tour stage is announced here too.
events.postWindow: Watch live, publish within four hours. Confirm the date in early October

reviewLog.note: ASO has not published an exact 2027 route presentation date, only that it will be late October 2026 at the Palais des Congres, Paris; the Edinburgh Grand Depart with stage 1 to Carlisle is independently confirmed elsewhere so the place text remains accurate.

events.name: Clocks go back — winter riding starts
events.place: UK. BST ends at 02:00 on the last Sunday in October
events.angle: Your best affiliate week of the autumn: lights, mudguards, layering, indoor training. Also the moment to push winter training camps.
events.postWindow: Winter kit guide live Mon 19 Oct, a full week early

reviewLog.note: 2026-10-25 is indeed the last Sunday in October 2026, when UK BST ends at 02:00.

events.name: Bespoked Osaka
events.place: G-LION Museum, Osaka, Japan. Late October, exact dates not fixed
events.angle: Dates are now firm — Fri 23 to Sun 25 October, trade day included. Same craft-not-product pitch as Bespoked Dresden, aimed at the English-speaking Japanese framebuilding audience.
events.postWindow: Confirm-dates post live Mon 19 Oct; show posts 23-25 Oct

reviewLog.note: Dates are now confirmed as Fri 23 (trade day) through Sun 25 October 2026 at the G-LION Museum, not the wider 26-31 October window previously listed.

events.priorityRationale: Cheap reach for a niche audience, but no direct link to UK readers or affiliate programmes — stays low priority even with dates now confirmed.

events.name: Bell's Iceman Cometh Challenge
events.place: Kalkaska to Traverse City, Michigan — 30-mile point-to-point, 5,400 riders across 77 age divisions plus 300 children. Ice Cycle Expo on the Friday
events.angle: The biggest single-day MTB race in America and it runs in near-freezing conditions — perfect timing for a cold-weather clothing and tyre-choice piece, right when your UK readers are facing the same problem.
events.postWindow: Cold-weather kit guide Mon 2 Nov; race posts Sat 7 Nov

events.name: Rouleur Live
events.place: The Truman Brewery, London — 80+ brands and riders on stage. Thu 17:00–22:00, Fri 13:00–20:00, Sat 10:00–16:00
events.angle: Go in person. Highest density of cycling media, brands and affiliate managers in the UK calendar, in one room, in one day. Your SEO analysis put backlinks and domain authority as the ranking gap — this is where you close it.
events.postWindow: Attend Thursday evening or Saturday; post live, round-up the following Tuesday

events.name: Granfondo Ecuador
events.place: Salinas, Ecuador — UCI World Series qualifier on the country's westernmost point
events.angle: Only worth a mention inside a "where to qualify for the 2027 amateur Worlds" round-up. Not a standalone post.
events.postWindow: Fold into a single World Series round-up in mid-November

events.name: El Tour de Tucson
events.place: Tucson, Arizona — 43rd edition. Around 11,000 riders on 102, 62 and 32-mile routes, plus family rides. Charity fundraiser, over $138m raised since 1983
events.angle: The best mass-participation road event in the US calendar and the clearest example of the charity-ride model, which barely exists in the UK the same way. Also: warm November riding, which is exactly what your readers are daydreaming about that week.
events.postWindow: Warm-weather escapes piece Mon 16 Nov; event posts Sat 21 Nov

events.name: Granfondo Siete Lagos
events.place: San Martín de los Andes to Villa la Angostura, Patagonia — first UCI gran fondo in Argentina
events.angle: Bucket-list scenery. Good imagery for a "gran fondos worth travelling for in 2027" piece.
events.postWindow: Fold into the World Series round-up

events.name: CX World Cup R1 — Ostrava
events.place: Ostrava, Czechia — new venue, racing under lights on a Friday night
events.angle: Season opener. One CX explainer — tyres, pressure, gearing — reused across all eight rounds to New Year. Clash on 2026-11-27: also competing for the feed post against Black Friday to Cyber Monday.
events.postWindow: Explainer Wed 25 Nov; race post Fri 27 Nov

events.name: Black Friday to Cyber Monday
events.place: Global. Black Friday 27 Nov, Cyber Monday 30 Nov
events.angle: The affiliate week. Pages must be live and indexed by mid-November or they earn nothing — Google will not rank a deals page published on the day. Clash on 2026-11-27: also competing for the feed post against CX World Cup R1 — Ostrava.
events.postWindow: Publish and index by Fri 13 Nov. Refresh daily 27–30 Nov

events.name: CX World Cup R2 — Tábor
events.place: Tábor, Czechia — 18th time hosting
events.angle: Reuse the CX explainer with a fresh top image.
events.postWindow: Sun 29 Nov

events.name: UCI Cycling Esports World Championships — final
events.place: Two venues, one in North America and one in Europe, riders racing on MyWhoosh
events.angle: Closes the loop on the September and October posts. Pair with an indoor-training piece — your audience is on a trainer that week anyway.
events.postWindow: Sat 12 Dec, plus an indoor training guide the Monday before

events.name: CX World Cup R3 — Glasgow
events.place: Kelvingrove Park, Glasgow — first World Cup round in Britain in over a decade. Free to spectate
events.angle: The UK cycling story of December, and free to attend. Search volume will spike with almost no competition for it yet — build the preview page early.
events.postWindow: Preview live by Mon 7 Dec; posts on the day Sun 13 Dec

events.name: CX World Cup R4 — Antwerp
events.place: Scheldecross, Antwerp, Belgium
events.angle: The Christmas block starts here — six rounds in nine days. Batch and schedule all of them before the 18th.
events.postWindow: Sat 19 Dec

events.name: CX World Cup R5 — Koksijde
events.place: Duinencross, Koksijde, Belgium — the sand dunes
events.angle: Sand riding technique. Most visually distinctive round of the series.
events.postWindow: Sun 20 Dec

events.name: Rapha Festive 500
events.place: Anywhere — 500km between Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve. Free to join, tracked on Strava
events.angle: Highest-engagement week of the winter and it costs nothing to enter. Publish a planning tool: 500km split into eight rides, with gearing and winter-kit checklists.
events.postWindow: Planning post Mon 21 Dec; daily posts 24–31 Dec

events.name: CX World Cup R6 — Gavere
events.place: Gavere, Belgium — Boxing Day mud
events.angle: Boxing Day is dead for most publishers and alive for cycling. Scheduled posts do well.
events.postWindow: Sat 26 Dec, scheduled in advance

events.name: CX World Cup R7 — Namur
events.place: Citadelcross, Namur, Belgium — the hardest course on the calendar
events.angle: Steepest course of the series. Genuinely good gradient content in a discipline nobody applies it to.
events.postWindow: Sun 27 Dec

events.name: CX World Cup R8 — Besançon
events.place: Besançon, France
events.angle: Year-end wrap. Link it to the Festive 500 posts and your 2027 preview.
events.postWindow: Tue 29 Dec, then the year in review on 31 Dec

events.name: UAE Tour
events.place: Multiple stages across Abu Dhabi and Dubai, UAE — includes a Jebel Hafeet summit finish
events.angle: Season-opener with a Jebel Hafeet summit finish — build a 3D climb morph for it ahead of the race, the same treatment the Vuelta stages get, and it's evergreen because the climb barely changes year to year. Clash on 2027-02-15: also competing for the feed post against Zwift Games.
events.postWindow: Climb page live Fri 12 Feb 2027, race posts 15-21 Feb

reviewLog.note: WorldTour season-opener with a Jebel Hafeet summit finish, good early-season watch content.

events.priorityRationale: Watch-only WorldTour opener, good traffic but not UK-specific; UAE Tour takes the feed post on 15 Feb over Zwift Games, which starts the same day and gets a stories mention instead.

events.name: Volta ao Algarve
events.place: Algarve region, southern Portugal
events.angle: The Algarve is the default UK winter training-camp destination — pair race coverage with a training-camp guide that carries your Stay22 and Booking.com affiliate links, the same play as the La Nucia piece in October.
events.postWindow: Training-camp guide live Mon 8 Feb 2027; race posts 17-21 Feb

reviewLog.note: Popular winter-training-camp destination for UK cyclists, good fit for affiliate booking content.

events.priorityRationale: Direct affiliate-revenue angle for a 40+ audience already booking winter camps; ranks above a pure watch-only race.

events.name: Vuelta a Andalucia (Ruta del Sol)
events.place: Andalucia, Spain — multi-stage race through popular UK winter-training roads
events.angle: Andalucia's WorldTour stage race climbs through the same training roads as the La Nucia gran fondo — a natural second use for the 3D climb visualiser built for that event in October.
events.postWindow: Stage previews 16-17 Feb; daily posts 18-22 Feb

reviewLog.note: Early-season WorldTour stage race through Andalucia's climbing terrain.

events.priorityRationale: Reuses existing October climb-data work for minimal extra effort; solid watch audience.

events.name: Clasica de Almeria
events.place: Almeria, Andalucia, Spain
events.angle: One-day season-opener with limited unique content potential beyond a quick startlist post.
events.postWindow: Single post Sun 14 Feb 2027, if the week is thin

reviewLog.note: One-day season-opener that often kicks off Andalucia racing week.

events.priorityRationale: Low-priority curtain-raiser; skip unless nothing else is running that week.

events.name: Clasica Jaen Paraiso Interior
events.place: Province of Jaen, Andalucia, Spain
events.angle: Punchy short climbs decided by pure gradient — the 3D climb visualiser was built for exactly this kind of course and it's under-used on short one-day races.
events.postWindow: Gradient breakdown Fri 12 Feb 2027; race post Tue 16 Feb

reviewLog.note: Punchy, climb-heavy one-day race, good tie-in for gradient/climb-profile content.

events.priorityRationale: Small race but a strong, cheap content match for the climb visualiser.

events.name: Vuelta a Murcia
events.place: Region de Murcia, Spain
events.angle: Compact stage race with no standout climb or UK angle — a line in a broader Andalucia-week round-up rather than its own post.
events.postWindow: Fold into the mid-February Spanish stage-race round-up

reviewLog.note: Compact early-season Spanish stage race, same fortnight as the bigger Andalucia races.

events.priorityRationale: Same week as bigger Spanish racing; not worth a standalone post.

events.name: Tour de la Provence
events.place: Provence, southern France — frequently touches Mont Ventoux's lower slopes
events.angle: Regularly touches the lower slopes of Mont Ventoux, which already has Tour de France climb data on the site — repost that data with a fresh 2027 hook rather than building anything new.
events.postWindow: Ventoux data repost Thu 11 Feb 2027; race posts 12-14 Feb

reviewLog.note: French season-opener that regularly features Mont Ventoux, matching the site's Grand Tour climb data.

events.priorityRationale: Cheapest possible content — reuses existing Grand Tour climb data almost unchanged.

events.name: Zwift Games
events.place: Online, via Zwift platform — multi-week stage format with open qualification
events.angle: Open-entry indoor esports series landing exactly when UK readers are riding indoors — follow-up piece to the MyWhoosh esports qualifier posts already on the calendar, this time for Zwift. Clash on 2027-02-15: also competing for the feed post against UAE Tour.
events.postWindow: Explainer Fri 12 Feb 2027, before the opening stage

reviewLog.note: Open-entry indoor esports series relevant to the 40+ audience training indoors through UK winter.

events.priorityRationale: Same treatment as the MyWhoosh esports posts; clashes with UAE Tour's opening day on 15 Feb, which takes the feed post — this becomes a stories-only mention that day.
